user.title: Control4 Audio
user.description: Add one amplifier or matrix switch. Repeat this flow for each additional chassis.

names.title: Zones and sources
names.description: One name per line, physical jack 1 at the top. Put a single hyphen on a line to skip that jack (no entity).

link.title: Matrix switch carry-through
link.description: If this amp is fed by a Control4 audio switch, link it. Feeds are amp_input=switch_output (default 1=1 means amp input 1 is switch output 1). Selecting WiiM on a room then routes the switch and the amp together.

error.cannot_connect: No UDP reply on port 8750. Check the IP and that Director is not blocking the chassis.

abort.already_configured: That IP address is already set up.

init.title: Zone and source names
init.description: Editing {model}. One name per line. Hyphen skips a jack. Link a switch so amp rooms show matrix sources.
